own-03.t: Missing reading, same pattern as own-04: 'not bipolar' may only say which depression is meant, so a dataset with an MDD group next to a bipolar group stays (c1 = unipolar depression & c3 & c4; plan can't hold). The current tree drops any dataset with a bipolar participant.

own-05.t: Missing reading: 'anything but 7T' can apply to the T2/FLAIR images only (c3 same_scan:c1,c2), so a dataset with 7T fMRI but 3T T2/FLAIR stays. Both current trees drop any dataset with a 7T scan.

own-14.t: c3-c5 attach to the whole dataset, so a dataset with a separate depression group goes. 'People with chronic pain, free of depression' describes the same people, as in own-17 (same_subject:c2; plan can't hold). Missing that reading, and own-14 and own-17 should be handled the same way.

own-16.t: The and/or readings are fine, but c3/c4 attach to the dataset; 'autism without ID' describes the autism group (same_subject:c2), as in own-17. The same-person reading is missing.

own-17.t: Fine. But own-14 and own-16 have the same 'patients without comorbidity' pattern, put it at dataset level and call it representable.

own-22.t: '(fMRI, EEG, fNIRS...)' lists examples (cf. ch-33): the request is any brain-signal modality, not just these three. Mark c1-c3 as examples or widen the list (MEG, iEEG, PET ...).

own-29.t: Should be ambiguous: 'resting-state' can cover the EEG too (c1 same_scan:c2,c3). The data holds this as attach_alternatives, but the page shows only one reading and the item is flagged not ambiguous.

own-31.t: c2 'decoding' is the user's analysis goal, not a property of the dataset; as a must clause it misses most fitting datasets. Drop it or make it a wish. Also 'no RS' may only say which runs are wanted (as own-11 reading 2): c1 & c3 & c4 & c5 is missing.

own-33.t: Missing reading: 'not MP2RAGE' may only say which anatomical scan is wanted (as own-11 reading 2), so a dataset with both MPRAGE and MP2RAGE stays: c1 & c2 & c3 & c4 & c6. 'Already looked at HCP' could also be a wish to exclude HCP.

own-35.t: 'No paediatric cases' = adults. The plan holds age: adults (own-15), the same way own-37 turns 'no animals' into species: human. So it should be representable via c4 -> age: adults.

ch-03.t: 'Such as' could make the list examples (cf. ch-33), but excluding any comorbidity is not a sensible intent here.

ch-08.t: Co-occurrence: a & !b lets through a person who has both. 'a other than b' means 'some a that is not b' and needs its own clause (like own-04 c3). Here: someone on an antipsychotic plus an SSRI passes.

ch-12.t: Chia's own annotation puts 'within the last month' on drug use only: !(a | b | (c & t)), with 'no pain' meaning currently. Probably weaker than the draft's reading, but a real second reading.

ch-16.t: Co-occurrence: a & !b lets through a person who has both. 'a other than b' means 'some a that is not b' and needs its own clause (like own-04 c3). Here: a GI disorder caused by another drug, in someone also on MPA, passes.

ch-17.t: Missing reading. Taken literally, the text says the criterion 'does not apply' to anyone who had a single febrile convulsion, which gives (a & !b) | c. The intended reading still excludes later seizures in such a person: (seizures other than that one febrile convulsion) | c.

ch-39.t: Same structure as ch-38, which lists a | (b & t) as a second reading. Add it here, or drop it there.
